csv_project_name: Engineer for Henry C. Chambers Waterfront Park Relieving
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Beaufort is seeking a qualified multidisciplinary consultant team to provide marine, coastal, geotechnical, and structural engineering, landscape architecture, NEPA and environmental review support, permitting, grant writing & administration, public engagement, bidding assistance, and related services for Option 2 of the Preserving the Promenade Henry C. Chambers Waterfront Park Relieving Platform Project. The project is intended to restore safe public access to one of Beaufort s most important civic and waterfront spaces, improve long-term resilience, preserve the historic and cultural character of Henry C. Chambers Waterfront Park, address structural and coastal vulnerabilities, improve maintainability, support downtown businesses and tourism, and position the City for federal, state, and other funding opportunities.
